## Project title

Sirius Travel Digital Content and Promotional Strategy

## Data and source

The project will use publicly available Sirius Travel website and social media content, along with examples of promotional materials I created.

## Managerial problem

It can be difficult to explain both the trip and the astronomical event clearly to prospective travelers.

## Target audience

Prospective travelers interested in astronomy, eclipse travel, and educational group experiences.

## Research questions and objectives

- Which content themes explain the tour experience most clearly?
- How can messaging remain consistent across social media and promotional materials?
- How are calls to action used to guide interested visitors toward more information?

## Expected impact

I expect the project to create a clearer and more consistent approach for presenting specialized tours.

## Planned methods

Content review, audience segmentation, brand and message review, channel planning, and a review of public engagement measures.

The related [Revealjs analytics proposal](../../presentation.qmd) explains how public content and Google Trends data can be used to support future content decisions.
